meta.note: Vectors are raw GloVe rows packed as a little-endian Float32Array (row-major, one row per word in 'words' order), base64-encoded. Cosine and analogy math normalize per-vector in the browser. true_neighbors are from the full 400K-word space; only this 500-word slice ships.

curated_analogies.label: king - man + woman

failure_candidates.teaches: Mixing unrelated clusters (geography minus country plus emotion) yields noise.
A familiar analogy frame breaks when the third term is from a far-off cluster.
Vocabulary arithmetic across unrelated domains produces an incoherent result.
